tips.text: Your team scores only while it has more living players on the hill than the enemy.
An even hill scores nothing. Bring one more friend than they did.
The match ends at {cfg:matchClock}. Most hill time wins. Nothing else counts.
The egg hatches at {cfg:hatchClock}. Whatever it was fed by then decides who it fights for.
Each biomass delivered is worth {cfg:biomassAllegiance} allegiance. Corruption gives {cfg:corruptionAllegiance}, and costs far more than it pays.
Each corruption delivered adds {cfg:corruptionInstability} instability. At {cfg:berserkThreshold}, the egg is lost to berserk for good.
Tied allegiance at the hatch leaves the Kaiju neutral. It fights whoever hit it in the last {cfg:kaijuNeutralMemory} s.
A berserk Kaiju attacks both sides, but it hunts the bigger biomass feeder harder.
Farmers gather in {cfg:farmerGather} s and carry {cfg:farmerCarry}. Everyone else takes {cfg:baseGather} s and carries {cfg:baseCarry}.
Root seeds slow every enemy they land on by {cfg:rootSlowPct}% for {cfg:rootSlowSeconds} s. Aim at the hill's edge.
A raised Warrior shield takes {cfg:shieldReductionPct}% off hits from the front. Face the trouble, not the exit.
Every pick swing knocks a wall down a stage: intact, cracked, gone. Walls are only suggestions to a Miner.
A Miner keeps up to {cfg:barricadeMax} barricades standing, {cfg:barricadeLife} s each, unless someone breaks them first.
Knocked out? You are back in {cfg:respawnSeconds} s, and nothing can hurt you for {cfg:protectionSeconds} s after.
The Kaiju's slam marks the ground {cfg:slamTelegraph} s before it lands. Leave the circle; it reaches {cfg:slamRadius} m.
A knocked-out Kaiju sleeps {cfg:kaijuKoSeconds} s, then gets up with full health and a grudge.
Biomass plants regrow in {cfg:biomassRegrow} s. Violet corruption growths take {cfg:corruptionRegrow} s.
Every step toward the shrine is a step off the hill. Send carriers, not the whole team.
Carriers are slow targets with full pockets. Escort yours, and hunt theirs.
While you wait to respawn, you can pick a different class.
Jump gaps and ledges to reach routes the crowd ignores.
Stand in your base fountain to heal. Knocked-out enemies drop meat; the egg eats that too.
Miners dig ground out and place it elsewhere. A new ramp beats a long road.
Demolitions mines are visible to everyone. The trick is where you put them, not hiding them.
Anyone can carry a Builder's ladder or rope bridge, including the enemy. Guard your shortcuts.
